list.name: kind
list.label: Type
list.query: Futures : future, Call options : call, Put options : put, Spreads & other : other

list.name: ticker
list.label: Contract
list.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}([CP][0-9]+)?$') THEN 'other'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'C' THEN 'call'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'P' THEN 'put'
      ELSE 'future'
    END AS kind
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT ticker
FROM d
WHERE kind IN ($kind)
GROUP BY ticker
ORDER BY sum(regular_trades) DESC NULLS LAST, max(open_interest) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Settlement price
panels.description: Daily settlement per selected contract, or last traded price when there is no settlement (options); DI1 settlements are PUs.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}([CP][0-9]+)?$') THEN 'other'

    END AS kind

  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price)::DOUBLE AS price
FROM d
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND kind IN ($kind)
  AND coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price) IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Return since start of range
panels.description: Settlement (or last price) relative to each contract's first value in the range, to compare contracts on one scale.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}([CP][0-9]+)?$') THEN 'other'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'C' THEN 'call'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'P' THEN 'put'
      ELSE 'future'
    END AS kind
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price)::DOUBLE AS price
  FROM d
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND kind IN ($kind)
    AND coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT time, ticker, price / nullif(first_value(price) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY time), 0) - 1 AS return
FROM daily
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Daily change
panels.description: Settlement vs the previous settlement (or last price vs the previous traded price), per selected contract.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}([CP][0-9]+)?$') THEN 'other'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'C' THEN 'call'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'P' THEN 'put'
      ELSE 'future'
    END AS kind
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
changes AS (
  SELECT
    trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
    ticker,
    coalesce(
      adjusted_quote::DOUBLE / nullif(prev_adjusted_quote::DOUBLE, 0),
      coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price)::DOUBLE / nullif(lag(coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price)::DOUBLE) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY trad_dt), 0)
    ) - 1 AS change
  FROM d
  WHERE kind IN ($kind)
    AND coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT time, ticker, change
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Trades by underlying (top 10)
panels.description: Daily regular trades of the 10 most traded underlyings (first 3 ticker letters) in the selected types, stacked; ignores the contract filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}([CP][0-9]+)?$') THEN 'other'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'C' THEN 'call'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'P' THEN 'put'
      ELSE 'future'
    END AS kind
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
u AS (
  SELECT left(ticker, 3) AS underlying, trad_dt, regular_trades
  FROM d
  WHERE kind IN ($kind)
),
top AS (
  SELECT underlying
  FROM u
  GROUP BY underlying
  ORDER BY sum(regular_trades) DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, underlying, sum(regular_trades)::BIGINT AS trades
FROM u
WHERE underlying IN (SELECT underlying FROM top)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, underlying

panels.title: Active contracts per day by type
panels.description: Daily count of listed contracts and of contracts with at least one regular trade, per selected type; ignores the contract filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}([CP][0-9]+)?$') THEN 'other'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'C' THEN 'call'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'P' THEN 'put'
      ELSE 'future'
    END AS kind
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    trad_dt,
    ticker,
    regular_trades,
    CASE kind WHEN 'future' THEN 'Futures' WHEN 'call' THEN 'Call options' WHEN 'put' THEN 'Put options' ELSE 'Spreads & other' END AS type
  FROM d
  WHERE kind IN ($kind)
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, type || ' traded' AS series, count(DISTINCT ticker) FILTER (WHERE regular_trades > 0) AS contracts
FROM labeled
GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, type || ' listed' AS series, count(DISTINCT ticker) AS contracts
FROM labeled
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Selected contracts (latest day in range)
panels.description: Prices, settlement, rate and open interest of the selected contracts on the latest day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}([CP][0-9]+)?$') THEN 'other'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'C' THEN 'call'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'P' THEN 'put'
      ELSE 'future'
    END AS kind
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
s AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM d
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND kind IN ($kind)
)
SELECT
  ticker,
  kind AS type,
  open_interest,
  regular_trades AS trades,
  first_price::DOUBLE AS open,
  max_price::DOUBLE AS high,
  min_price::DOUBLE AS low,
  avg_price::DOUBLE AS avg,
  last_price::DOUBLE AS last,
  adjusted_quote::DOUBLE AS settlement,
  prev_adjusted_quote::DOUBLE AS prev_settlement,
  adjusted_quote::DOUBLE / nullif(prev_adjusted_quote::DOUBLE, 0) - 1 AS settlement_change,
  adjusted_quote_rate::DOUBLE AS rate,
  prev_adjusted_quote_rate::DOUBLE AS prev_rate,
  coalesce(adjusted_quote_ccy, price_ccy) AS ccy
FROM s
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM s)
ORDER BY open_interest DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Top 20 by trades (range)
panels.description: Top 20 contracts by regular trades in the selected types; ignores the contract filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}([CP][0-9]+)?$') THEN 'other'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'C' THEN 'call'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'P' THEN 'put'
      ELSE 'future'
    END AS kind
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  ticker,
  any_value(kind) AS type,
  sum(regular_trades)::BIGINT AS trades,
  count(regular_trades) AS days_traded,
  arg_max(open_interest, trad_dt) AS last_open_interest,
  arg_max(coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price)::DOUBLE, trad_dt) AS last_price,
  arg_max(coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price)::DOUBLE, trad_dt) / nullif(arg_min(coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price)::DOUBLE, trad_dt), 0) - 1 AS period_return
FROM d
WHERE kind IN ($kind)
GROUP BY ticker
ORDER BY trades DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top gainers (100+ trades)
panels.description: Top 15 settlement (or last price) returns over the range among contracts with 100+ regular trades in the selected types; ignores the contract filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}([CP][0-9]+)?$') THEN 'other'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'C' THEN 'call'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'P' THEN 'put'
      ELSE 'future'
    END AS kind
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
r AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    any_value(kind) AS type,
    arg_min(coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price)::DOUBLE, trad_dt) AS first_price,
    arg_max(coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price)::DOUBLE, trad_dt) AS last_price,
    sum(regular_trades)::BIGINT AS trades
  FROM d
  WHERE kind IN ($kind)
    AND ticker <> 'TT6Z99'
  GROUP BY ticker
  HAVING sum(regular_trades) >= 100
)
SELECT *, last_price / first_price - 1 AS period_return
FROM r
WHERE first_price > 0
  AND last_price > 0
ORDER BY period_return DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top losers (100+ trades)
panels.description: Bottom 15 settlement (or last price) returns over the range among contracts with 100+ regular trades in the selected types; ignores the contract filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}([CP][0-9]+)?$') THEN 'other'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'C' THEN 'call'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'P' THEN 'put'
      ELSE 'future'
    END AS kind
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
r AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    any_value(kind) AS type,
    arg_min(coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price)::DOUBLE, trad_dt) AS first_price,
    arg_max(coalesce(adjusted_quote, last_price)::DOUBLE, trad_dt) AS last_price,
    sum(regular_trades)::BIGINT AS trades
  FROM d
  WHERE kind IN ($kind)
    AND ticker <> 'TT6Z99'
  GROUP BY ticker
  HAVING sum(regular_trades) >= 100
)
SELECT *, last_price / first_price - 1 AS period_return
FROM r
WHERE first_price > 0
  AND last_price > 0
ORDER BY period_return ASC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Biggest open interest changes (range)
panels.description: Top 15 absolute open interest changes from the first to the last day in the range, in the selected types; ignores the contract filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}([CP][0-9]+)?$') THEN 'other'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'C' THEN 'call'
      WHEN ticker[7:7] = 'P' THEN 'put'
      ELSE 'future'
    END AS kind
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_derivatives/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
r AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    any_value(kind) AS type,
    arg_min(open_interest, trad_dt) AS first_oi,
    arg_max(open_interest, trad_dt) AS last_oi
  FROM d
  WHERE kind IN ($kind)
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT ticker, type, first_oi, last_oi, last_oi - first_oi AS oi_change
FROM r
WHERE first_oi IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY abs(last_oi - first_oi) DESC
LIMIT 15
